library.pt_280:r_5262980a4011b3b5.text:
A member of Jindai High School's karate club.
She trains toward a form of mixed martial arts built for ultra-practical combat.
Incidentally, that name is not her real one - it is simply what $$かなめ$$ calls her.

library.pt_280:r_a9026a6fce1e22de.text:
A member of Jindai High School's karate club.
She trains toward a form of mixed martial arts built for ultra-practical combat.
Incidentally, that name is not her real one - it is simply what $$かなめ$$ calls her.
When $$宗介$$ and the others came to serve the club an eviction notice, she flatly opposed it and challenged them to a fight. But $$宗介$$ throws a hand grenade at her, and while she is thrown off balance, the opening is exploited and she is defeated.

library.pt_280:r_e2f47396b7cdc149.text:
The caretaker at Jindai High School.
He has a mild-mannered personality, but seems to have grown somewhat disillusioned with the youth of today.

library.pt_280:r_986e11632cfe87ea.text:
The caretaker at Jindai High School.
He has a mild-mannered personality, but seems to have grown somewhat disillusioned with the youth of today.
He is caught up in a fight between $$宗介$$ and $$一成$$ and gets hurt, and the carp he had raised like grandchildren are cooked by the two of them. As a result, he transforms from his usual old-man demeanor into a high-tension killer (of sorts), and wielding a chainsaw, chases $$宗介$$ and $$一成$$ around all night, terrifying them to the core.

library.pt_280:r_05a3708ffd3f37ae.text:
A policewoman assigned to the Traffic Division.
She burns with an abnormal obsession for arresting criminals, and will disregard everything else to do so - a reckless personality.
She handles her mini patrol car with masterful driving skill, and boasts excellent reflexes and genius-level marksmanship as well.

library.pt_280:r_85eb6b911a4ae55e.text:
A policewoman assigned to the Traffic Division.
She burns with an abnormal obsession for arresting criminals, and will disregard everything else to do so - a reckless personality.
She handles her mini patrol car with masterful driving skill, and boasts excellent reflexes and genius-level marksmanship as well.
She chased down $$宗介$$ and the others as they rode double on a bicycle with breathtaking driving technique, and once fought a fierce shootout against Bon-ta-kun.

library.pt_280:r_7cf514f218765fbc.text:
A mysterious monster with an abnormal obsession for ponytails.
He repeatedly commits the crime of forcibly giving women ponytails on the night streets.

library.pt_280:r_41b29b1494ba5904.text:
A mysterious monster with an abnormal obsession for ponytails.
He repeatedly commits the crime of forcibly giving women ponytails on the night streets.
He is caught thanks to the efforts of $$宗介$$, $$かなめ$$, and the others, but his true identity turns out to be a young man who simply loves ponytails.

library.pt_280:r_923408beb698ebc6.text:
A mercenary belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$.
His rank is Lieutenant. His AS is the $$Ｍ９Ｄ　ファルケ$$.
He transfers from the Mediterranean Fleet to the Western Pacific Fleet and becomes team leader of the $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team).
His personality is calm, composed, and strict. Soon after taking up his post, he provokes $$宗介$$ and the others by deliberately insulting his dead comrade McCallen in order to retrain them, showing that he is hard not only on his subordinates but on himself.
His specialty is martial arts, which he regards not merely as a fighting sport but as a way of life as a warrior. Even in AS close combat, he has shown the skill to overwhelm $$宗介$$ in a mock battle.

library.pt_280:r_270e4777a0951f3b.text:
The AI of the $$ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト$$. Voice-response type.
It registers $$宗介$$, who piloted the Arbalest for the first time, as its official pilot, and continues to optimize itself around him.
Afterward this setting could no longer be changed, and the Lambda Driver became unusable for anyone but him. Even when $$宗介$$ operates it, however, the Lambda Driver's activation is unreliable, repeatedly putting him in dangerous situations.
$$宗介$$ dislikes this as a lack of reliability in a weapon, and feels an aversion toward both $$アル$$ and the unit itself.

library.pt_280:r_061ad9b495bade69.text:
The AI of the $$ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト$$. Voice-response type.
It registers $$宗介$$, who piloted the Arbalest for the first time, as its official pilot, and continues to optimize itself around him.
Afterward this setting could no longer be changed, and the Lambda Driver became unusable for anyone but him. Even when $$宗介$$ operates it, however, the Lambda Driver's activation is unreliable, repeatedly putting him in dangerous situations.
$$宗介$$ dislikes this as a lack of reliability in a weapon, and feels an aversion toward both $$アル$$ and the unit itself.
However, through the string of battles in Hong Kong, $$アル$$ welcomes back a $$宗介$$ who has cast off his inner hesitation, and together they achieve a masterful combination that destroys $$ゲイツ$$ and the others. $$宗介$$ comes to call $$アル$$ his 'partner', and at the same time, as $$アル$$ puts it, a 'flag has been raised' - and despite being an AI, it grows increasingly human.

library.pt_280:r_cf1c2602ed64c4eb.text:
A member of $$ミスリル$$ Intelligence's Hong Kong branch.
He looks like an honest, ordinary salaryman, and operates publicly as a trader.
When $$宗介$$ and the others were active in Hong Kong, he supplied the information and materiel needed for their operations.

library.pt_280:r_9596c4cd5a63a6c2.text:
A member of $$ミスリル$$ Intelligence. $$レイス$$ is a codename.
She is engaged in Operation Guardian Angel, which aims to prevent $$千鳥かなめ$$, a $$ウィスパード$$, from falling into the hands of another organization. In parallel with $$宗介$$, she secretly guarded $$かなめ$$.
She is a master of disguise, with many different faces and voices.

library.pt_280:r_56cbb34d1ce013bb.text:
A member of $$ミスリル$$ Intelligence. $$レイス$$ is a codename.
She is engaged in Operation Guardian Angel, which aims to prevent $$千鳥かなめ$$, a $$ウィスパード$$, from falling into the hands of another organization. In parallel with $$宗介$$, she secretly guarded $$かなめ$$, but there was no coordination between the two, and $$宗介$$ was never informed of her existence.
She is a master of disguise with many different faces and voices, and when $$かなめ$$ made contact with her, she was disguised as an inconspicuous middle-aged man.
When $$玉蘭$$ attacked $$かなめ$$, she was shot and wounded, effectively failing her mission.
After $$かなめ$$ pulled through the crisis on her own, $$レイス$$ lamented her own inadequacy, but was scolded by $$かなめ$$ and ended up escorting her all the way to Hong Kong.
Incidentally, her true identity is female.

library.pt_280:r_672ed89c58da7138.text:
A $$ミスリル$$ executive, a general officer in the Intelligence division.
Incidentally, the Operations division to which the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ belongs and the Intelligence division do not get along well, due to differences in their standing.

library.pt_280:r_f3b1019d18cee233.text:
A $$ミスリル$$ executive.
A person said to be one of $$ミスリル$$'s founders.

library.pt_280:r_0d2ea9aa23750fdd.text:
A $$ミスリル$$ executive.
A general officer in the Operations division, and also $$テッサ$$'s superior officer.
He is a mild-mannered man with great ability as a leader.
Incidentally, he has long been acquainted with $$テッサ$$'s father, Carl Testarossa, and maintains a personal friendship with his daughter $$テッサ$$ as well.

library.pt_280:r_57ef81a6d94e3a8d.text:
An executive of the secret organization Amalgam.
Within the organization he is called 'Mr. Ag (Silver)'.
He is $$テッサ$$'s older brother by blood, and like her is also a '$$ウィスパード$$', possessing extensive knowledge of Black Technology.
His manner is gentle and gentlemanly, but he also carries a forcefulness that brooks no argument, and his true intentions are impossible to pin down.
He acts alone, accompanied by $$アラストル$$, the world's smallest AS.

library.pt_280:r_cceaead443494762.text:
An executive of the secret organization Amalgam.
Within the organization he is called 'Mr. Ag (Silver)'.
He is $$テッサ$$'s older brother by blood, and like her is also a '$$ウィスパード$$', possessing extensive knowledge of Black Technology.
His manner is gentle and gentlemanly, but he also carries a forcefulness that brooks no argument, and his true intentions are impossible to pin down.
He acts alone, accompanied by $$アラストル$$, the world's smallest AS.
He appears when $$玉蘭$$ attacks $$かなめ$$, and orders $$アラストル$$ to kill $$玉蘭$$. He then confesses his affection for $$かなめ$$ and steals a kiss from her.

library.pt_280:r_ffb7d97960488b40.text:
The world's smallest autonomous AS, developed by $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$.
It acts as $$レナード$$'s escort, serving as his bodyguard.
Its structure and mechanisms are extremely close to those of third-generation AS units, and advanced Black Technology was used to achieve its downsizing.

library.pt_280:r_a79345494c60b7e9.text:
The world's smallest autonomous AS, developed by $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$.
It acts as $$レナード$$'s escort, serving as his bodyguard.
Its structure and mechanisms are extremely close to those of third-generation AS units, and advanced Black Technology was used to achieve its downsizing.
Possessing speed, power, and a sturdy body beyond any comparison to a human, it overwhelmed $$玉蘭$$ - an assassin of extraordinary ability - in the blink of an eye.

library.pt_280:r_36b8d0bceb5d7015.text:
A member of the secret organization Amalgam.
A twisted pervert with warped tastes and personality. His emotions swing wildly, and he casually takes human lives while making cheerful remarks; his words and actions are eccentric and full of danger. At the same time, he also possesses a soldier's sharp insight and intellect, able to accurately analyze a battle from an aerial view of its aftermath alone.
He is also highly skilled at piloting an AS, to the point that $$ガウルン$$ calls him a 'master hand'. His unit is the $$プラン１０５６　コダール$$ i. He wields the Lambda Driver with ease, repeatedly driving $$宗介$$ and $$ミスリル$$ into desperate situations.
Incidentally, he is particular about his sideburns, and has claimed that their length is a matter of life and death.

library.pt_280:r_ccbee8f10de04b9d.text:
A member of the secret organization Amalgam.
A twisted pervert with warped tastes and personality. His emotions swing wildly, and he casually takes human lives while making cheerful remarks; his words and actions are eccentric and full of danger. At the same time, he also possesses a soldier's sharp insight and intellect, able to accurately analyze a battle from an aerial view of its aftermath alone.
He is also highly skilled at piloting an AS, to the point that $$ガウルン$$ calls him a 'master hand'. His unit is the $$プラン１０５６　コダール$$ i. He wields the Lambda Driver with ease, repeatedly driving $$宗介$$ and $$ミスリル$$ into desperate situations, but in Hong Kong he was defeated by a $$宗介$$ who had cast off his hesitation.
Incidentally, he is particular about his sideburns, and has claimed that their length is a matter of life and death.

library.pt_280:r_6f52e1c7ad8f6a80.text:
A girl belonging to the secret organization Amalgam. Sixteen years old.
Her name is read '$$夏玉芳$$'.
A highly trained assassin, skilled at piloting an AS.
She is always expressionless, but shows deep affection for her twin younger sister, $$玉蘭$$.

library.pt_280:r_be6dd6f36a986301.text:
A girl belonging to the secret organization Amalgam. Sixteen years old.
Her name is read '$$夏玉芳$$'.
A highly trained assassin, skilled at piloting an AS.
She is always expressionless, but shows deep affection for her twin younger sister, $$玉蘭$$. She also calls $$ガウルン$$, who trained her in combat, 'sensei', and is devoted to him.
In the incident inside the Yangtze River crossing tunnel, she pilots the $$Ｚｙ－９８　シャドウ$$ and fights $$クルツ$$'s M9, driving him to the very brink of defeat.
Afterward, in order to carry out $$ガウルン$$'s order to target $$宗介$$, she deserts the organization and destroys a section of Hong Kong to lure $$ミスリル$$ out, but in the end is purged by her former superior officer, $$ゲイツ$$.

library.pt_280:r_da6c4fd49621657d.text:
A girl belonging to the secret organization Amalgam. Sixteen years old.
Her name is read '$$夏玉蘭$$'.
A highly trained assassin with an extraordinary sense for close combat. She wields a machete and knives, carrying out her missions with the mechanical, expressionless efficiency of a machine. Her twin older sister $$玉芳$$ says this coldness comes from the fact that 'she never feels fear'.

library.pt_280:r_6d4f211dc79f485e.text:
A girl belonging to the secret organization Amalgam. Sixteen years old.
Her name is read '$$夏玉蘭$$'.
A highly trained assassin with an extraordinary sense for close combat. She wields a machete and knives, carrying out her missions with the mechanical, expressionless efficiency of a machine. Her twin older sister $$玉芳$$ says this coldness comes from the fact that 'she never feels fear'.
Like $$玉芳$$, she is devoted to $$ガウルン$$, their teacher in the art of combat.
In the incident inside the Yangtze River crossing tunnel, she poses as a victim to approach $$ミスリル$$, and drives $$マオ$$ to the brink of defeat in close combat.
Afterward, in order to carry out $$ガウルン$$'s order to target $$宗介$$, she deserts the organization and attempts to assassinate $$かなめ$$ in order to deal him a psychological blow, but meets an unexpected counterattack and fails. She later fights $$アラストル$$, who arrives with $$レナード$$, and dies.

library.pt_280:r_4f9e77a2a101ad58.text:
A member of Team D, and the main pilot of the Nova Eagle and Dancouga Nova.
Her catchphrase is 'Watch me pull this off!'
She is a racer who won three years running in F01, said to be the most extreme sport around, and also a top model active in billboard ads and more.
On the night she won the Shibuya Grand Prix for the third time, she is forcibly summoned to $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$. Though furious at being forced to fight in the Dancouga Nova regardless of her wishes, she experiences a thrill unlike anything she has ever felt, and in the end signs a contract because of it.
Her creed is to always win what she wants through her own strength, and her drive to rise is extremely strong. She hates to lose and is passionate, and has had many lovers in the past. But none ever seem to last long, and even after deciding to join Team D she went through a breakup with one man.
Once she learns the truth of the situation, she resolves without hesitation to head for the moon. Though she is nearly broken by the original Dancouga and almost succumbs to being haunted by her past as an abandoned child, she recovers thanks to the bonds with her comrades, and ultimately delivers the finishing blow to Moon WILL with her own fist.
What became of her after returning from the moon is unclear, but she has been seen riding off on her motorcycle.

library.pt_280:r_ce86cb26ab10542c.text:
A member of Team D and the pilot of the Nova Liger.
Her catchphrase is 'I'll get this done!'
She is a narcotics investigator with the Metropolitan Police Department, and was teleported to $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ just as she had captured the boss of an Asian drug syndicate. After experiencing combat in the Dancouga Nova, she accepted the scout's offer on the grounds that $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ seemed to hold more mysteries than any crime syndicate.
She excels at martial arts, reflexively throwing anyone who stands behind her. Her marksmanship is also first-rate, and $$ルゥ$$ Ririri often asked her for pointers. During Dancouga Nova's combination, she handles fire control, and it also falls to $$くらら$$ to pull the trigger on the Dankuu Cannon.
Perhaps because of a job that always keeps her close to death, she has the most mature outlook and thinking within the team, and a mental fortitude that does not flinch from danger. But she also shows a strangely childish side at times, such as delighting in $$葵$$'s extensive wardrobe or indulging in gun-shooting games in her private time.
When she heard $$ジョニー$$'s reason for joining the team, she pressed him on which of her and $$葵$$ he preferred, revealing a side of her that takes pride as a woman as well.
After Team D's fight came to an end, she showed herself again to Chou, her old partner from her narcotics days.

library.pt_280:r_4ebe307e6e9c2e5e.text:
A member of Team D and the pilot of the Nova Rhinoceros.
His catchphrase is 'I'll make it happen.'
Wanting to be alone and not wanting to be tied down by a cell phone or anything else, he had been living homeless, sleeping in a cardboard box in a park.
While enjoying his freedom to the fullest, he is suddenly summoned to $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ and experiences combat in the Dancouga Nova. When summoned again, he resolves to join in order to fill the emptiness in his heart that freedom alone could not satisfy.
The fact that he never seems to be short of money, along with glimpses of education in things like computers and flower arranging, hint at a part of the life he led before becoming homeless.
He is normally cool and detached, but in battle he often wants to shout out his catchphrase or welcomes his personal theme song, showing a hot-blooded, childish side as well.
Incidentally, after the combination he is troubled by having no role of his own, and asks $$セイミー$$ to develop a finishing move that would make use of the Nova Rhinoceros as its trigger.
He grows close with $$イザベル$$, whom he met at a party held by Igor Konzern, providing her with information about the Dancouga Nova, and after all the fighting was over, the two were seen standing side by side for a photo shoot in a bitterly cold locale.

library.pt_280:r_b0605482daf17ff9.text:
A member of Team D and the pilot of the Nova Elephant.
His catchphrase is 'I'll get it done, naturally.'
A top-flight sales rep once considered the leading candidate for the next company president, he was on his way to a meeting at the very moment he was teleported to $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.
He subscribes to about thirty magazines a month whose titles all begin with 'A Man's...' - 'A Man's Cooking', 'A Man's Warships', 'A Man's Rod-and-Reel Fishing', 'A Man's Aircraft', and so on. This is because he is searching for what he truly wants to do, and his career as a salaryman is nothing more than a stopgap. The same goes for why he threw himself into the fighting - when he signed his contract, he called it a 'trial period'. He also shows interest in and skillfully handles anything he turns his hand to, be it work, cooking, or combat. During Dancouga Nova's combination, he is in charge of output control, handling it flawlessly.
He had always been somewhat conscious of $$エイーダ$$, who graced the cover of a magazine he subscribed to, but the two grow closer after meeting at a party held by Igor Konzern. When he learns she is the pilot of the R-Daigan, an enemy unit, he is shocked, but chooses to join hands with her as 'yesterday's enemy, today's friend'.
After defeating Moon WILL and restoring peace, he was seen enjoying shopping with $$エイーダ$$ in the city.

library.pt_280:r_82563e045df6b5ce.text:
A national idol who climbed to her current status in barely a year since her debut.
She is active across many fields - major entertainment company Zolbrain's flagship games, commercials for Kerdonald Foods, and the cover of the magazine 'Monthly: A Man's Cooking', which $$ジョニー$$ himself subscribes to, among others.
She once lost out on a commercial appearance to $$ジョニー$$'s business skill, and since then took an interest in him, going so far as to gather information about him online. Eventually, at a party hosted by Igor Konzern, she meets $$ジョニー$$ in person, and the two grow drawn to each other.
Her true identity is the pilot of the R-Daigan.
Her catchphrase is 'I'm going to make this happen!'
Acting on $$ウラジミール$$'s orders, she repeatedly clashed with Team D. Eventually, right after she is prompted to activate her assigned role, the God Beast Mode, she is utterly beaten down, but her life is saved by $$ジョニー$$, who was quick to realize her true identity.
In the later battle against the Unknown, she shows outstanding teamwork with Team D, and when the team heads for the moon, she officially becomes one of its members.
After the final battle on the moon, with peace restored, she was seen enjoying shopping in the city with $$ジョニー$$.

library.pt_280:r_cebf40fea9771078.text:
The founder and supreme director of $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.
His public face is that of the president of Igor Konzern, a major entertainment conglomerate. Behind the scenes, he received backing from the leaders of nations in an international coalition and from mysterious billionaires, and built the Dancouga Nova.
His name is simply read as it is written, '$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$', but his real name is unknown. $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$ is taken from the initials of 'Fog Sweeper', meaning 'one who clears away the fog'.
He once belonged to Hokkaido's Institute of Cognitive Science Brain Research, where he encountered WILL, who had been damaged by a meteor impact. He agreed to cooperate with WILL, and together they organized $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.

library.pt_280:r_ded132cb12d282e0.text:
The commanding officer in charge of Team D.
He is mild-mannered and unassuming, always facing matters with a nonchalant, easygoing attitude.
He describes himself as nothing more than a middle manager within $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, and feigns ignorance whenever a conversation approaches the heart of the matter. But the sharp glint in his eyes and words that occasionally slip through hint at a shrewdness he keeps hidden.
He seems to have had his own private guesses about most things, including the purpose of the Dancouga Nova, and showed no particular surprise upon learning the truth.
When the existence of Moon WILL came to light, he initially opposed Team D's deployment in line with WILL's original plan, but in the end heads for the moon together with them.
What became of him after the fighting ended is unknown. Even his first name remained unknown to the very end.

library.pt_280:r_99c7d9c19c658922.text:
The main computer of $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$. Its name means 'will' or 'intent'.
At first its main role was to serve as an explainer in the command room, but gradually a great hidden secret began to come to light.
Its true nature is a self-aware machine, an inorganic intelligence, a being unlike any life on Earth.
In the distant past, there was a war between different civilizations that engulfed entire star systems. To prevent the same tragedy from repeating, it was created by the few surviving civilizations with the purpose of preemptively eliminating threats that might use advanced intelligence to wage war.
It viewed humanity as a dangerous existence, but also sensed in humanity's diversity and individual strength the possibility of a new path forward. When Moon WILL arrived anew, intent on destroying humanity based only on its present state, WILL built the Dancouga Nova together with $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$ as a means of resisting it.

library.pt_280:r_20eec8dfccf244ef.text:
$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$'s fourth-generation mental counselor. Fifteen years old.
Though young, she holds over one hundred licenses in psychiatry and psychology, and intensely dislikes being treated like a child. Incidentally, in Japan, where she lives, the age of adulthood is fifteen, and she insists at every opportunity that she is '15 years and 3 months old'.
She also dislikes having her name shortened to 'Riruri', and is put in a bad mood whenever someone calls her that.
Despite being a counselor, she is not good with men, and brings along a guard robot whenever she counsels $$ジョニー$$ or $$朔哉$$.
Beyond counseling, she is also skilled at piloting robots and the like.

library.pt_280:r_208eb4464a66a87f.text:
$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$'s chief mechanic.
She is a humanist who shows equal affection not only to the machines but to the pilots who operate them.
She also has strong analytical skills and is reliable in many situations, but her one flaw is her poor tolerance for alcohol. Once drunk, she loses all sense of gender boundaries, and has even made a pass at $$葵$$.
As for machines, she does not just maintain them but also develops new weapons, and it was at $$朔哉$$'s request that she fitted the Boost Nova Knuckle.

library.pt_280:r_ae555bf282cf4d5d.text:
The developer of the R-Daigan.
He is also the one who discovered and raised its pilot, $$エイーダ$$.
To secure funding, he has partnered with Zolbrain, a rival of Igor Konzern. He deftly manages the company president's wishes while keeping his own goals as his top priority.
He was once married to $$田中司令$$, and the two show a love-hate relationship, greeting each other with a slap followed by a kiss.
Incidentally, the design data for the R-Daigan was sent by WILL; $$ウラジミール$$ did not build it entirely from scratch.

library.pt_280:r_464a1747f8e153d9.text:
A journalist affiliated with BWC.
She harbors suspicions about the Dancouga Nova's actions and existence, and is known as the 'combat correspondent' for flying into battlefields without regard for her own safety.
She won a Pulitzer Prize for her collected reporting, titled 'Does the World Need the Dancouga?'
As she continues her activities, she comes under pressure from above, but holds firm to her conviction and keeps reporting regardless.
Eventually, her overreaching actions bring pressure down on the entire mass media industry, but she leaves her company rather than stop reporting. With information provided by $$朔哉$$, whom she met at a party hosted by Igor Konzern, she gradually closes in on the truth.
When WILL personally reveals the whole truth, she speaks as though she has given up on turning it into an article. But her resolve to keep covering the Dancouga as long as she lives never wavers, and she accompanies the team to the final battle on the moon, witnessing everything to the end.
After the fighting over the Dancouga came to an end, unable to suppress her journalistic instincts after all, she continued reporting on WILL.

library.pt_280:r_fadac61acb82b29c.text:
A young man known in Jiha Village as 'Digger $$シモン$$'.
As a boy he was timid and prone to keeping his worries bottled up inside, with digging holes as his only real talent. But using the Core Drill and Lagann he happened to dig up, he drives off a Gunmen that appears in the village. Together with $$カミナ$$, whom he looks up to as an older brother figure, and $$ヨーコ$$, who fights the Beastmen, he bursts out onto the surface.
As the fighting continues, he meets countless companions and eventually forms the Dai-Gurren Brigade. Though he loses $$カミナ$$ immediately afterward, his encounter with $$ニア$$ gives him the chance to move past his grief. As the leader of the Dai-Gurren Brigade, he becomes its true center in every sense, and ultimately achieves the defeat of the Spiral King, $$ロージェノム$$.
Afterward, he turns Teppelin, the former capital and stronghold of the Beastmen, into $$カミナ$$ City, establishes a new government to guide humanity, and becomes its first Supreme Commander.
His duties as Supreme Commander mostly consist of handling everyday complaints, and he spends his days struggling with a job he is not used to.

library.pt_280:r_f4fc166b99809cd9.text:
A young man known in Jiha Village as 'Digger $$シモン$$'.
As a boy he was timid and prone to keeping his worries bottled up inside, with digging holes as his only real talent. But using the Core Drill and Lagann he happened to dig up, he drives off a Gunmen that appears in the village. Together with $$カミナ$$, whom he looks up to as an older brother figure, and $$ヨーコ$$, who fights the Beastmen, he bursts out onto the surface.
As the fighting continues, he meets countless companions and eventually forms the Dai-Gurren Brigade. Though he loses $$カミナ$$ immediately afterward, his encounter with $$ニア$$ gives him the chance to move past his grief. As the leader of the Dai-Gurren Brigade, he becomes its true center in every sense, and ultimately achieves the defeat of the Spiral King, $$ロージェノム$$.
Afterward, he turns Teppelin, the former capital and stronghold of the Beastmen, into $$カミナ$$ City, establishes a new government to guide humanity, and becomes its first Supreme Commander.
His duties as Supreme Commander mostly consist of handling everyday complaints, and he spends his days struggling with a job he is not used to.
He was living out peaceful if tedious days, but that peace collapses when a child is born to $$ダヤッカ$$ and $$キヨウ$$. Their daughter $$アンネ$$ turns out to be exactly the one millionth of the 'one million monkeys' $$ロージェノム$$ left behind in his dying words, and this triggers $$ニア$$'s awakening as a Messenger of the Anti-Spiral, activating the Human Extermination System. On top of that, he is held responsible for his own careless actions as Supreme Commander, and is sentenced to death and imprisoned.
Amid the Anti-Spiral's continued attacks, his comrades break him out of his cell. Together with his former archenemy $$ヴィラル$$, who had been imprisoned alongside him, he boards $$グレンラガン$$ and heads into a new battle to win $$ニア$$ back.
At great cost, he achieves victory over the Anti-Spiral and gets $$ニア$$ back, but soon after must face an eternal parting from her. Afterward, he entrusts the Core Drill to $$ギミー$$ and sets off alone to parts unknown.

library.pt_280:r_b463a79b62a30ebb.text:
A boy known in Jiha Village as 'Digger $$シモン$$'.
Timid and prone to keeping his worries bottled up inside, but when it comes to digging holes, no one can match him.
One day, his unchanging daily life is upset when he happens to discover the Core Drill and Lagann. He drives off a Gunmen that appears in the village and, riding that momentum, bursts out onto the surface. He then sets off together with $$カミナ$$, whom he looks up to as an older brother figure, and $$ヨーコ$$, who fights the Beastmen, heading for the Beastmen's home base.
At first he is often fearful of battle and shows a timid side. But as he continues fighting alongside the strong, guiding $$カミナ$$ and $$ヨーコ$$, for whom he holds a faint longing, he gradually begins to grow.

library.pt_280:r_edb9086190a98f43.text:
A Beastman, former commander of the Beastman army's Anti-Human Suppression Force, Far East Division, under the Spiral King's $$フォウ$$ Heavenly Kings general Chimiruf.
He possesses great combat ability and a fierce temperament, but also has a side that values courtesy. He remains loyal and continues to pay respect to the late Spiral King $$ロージェノム$$, his superior officer Chimiruf, and the other Heavenly Kings even now.
His contact with $$カミナ$$ in a past battle, and his defeat at his hands, mark a turning point that greatly changes his view of humans, whom he had previously seen only as prey to be hunted. Eventually, he learns that $$カミナ$$ died without his knowledge, and is further defeated, this time by $$シモン$$.
As a result of the question 'what exactly are humans?', $$ロージェノム$$, intrigued by such un-Beastman-like thinking, grants him an immortal body.
After the fall of Teppelin, he throws himself into anti-government guerrilla activity against the new government.
After his defeat as a guerrilla, he is imprisoned, but is unexpectedly reunited with $$シモン$$. When the Human Extermination System is activated, he joins forces with his former archenemy to try to stop it.
Being a Beastman, he does not possess Spiral Power, but his outstanding skill at piloting Gunmen earns him a seat in Gurren. Laughing wryly at his own strange fate, he succeeds in the 'Fated Combination' with $$シモン$$.

library.pt_280:r_97a57725df83dadf.text:
A sniper from Littner Village.
She has a realistic, level-headed side, but also an honest, cheerful, straightforward personality, and could be called the mood-maker of the Dai-Gurren Brigade - though as the years passed, she grew into a woman with added composure and warmth.
She handles a sniper rifle bigger than she is with ease, and her marksmanship, once the pride of her village, has not dulled in the slightest.
After the new government was established, feeling it was not her place, she left her comrades and traveled alone to Korehana Island, where she took the name $$ヨマコ$$ and became a teacher.
As the world faces a new crisis, she resolves to fight for the sake of the children and rejoins the Dai-Gurren Brigade. She rescues $$シモン$$ and $$ヴィラル$$ from their peril in prison, then heads out into space.

library.pt_280:r_e66776ec33326f11.text:
The first princess of the Spiral King $$ロージェノム$$.
During the battle against the Spiral King, she emerges from a container $$シモン$$ discovers, and joins the Dai-Gurren Brigade as she is.
She is naive to an astonishing degree, with an extremely pure, easygoing personality. Moreover, as the enemy commander's daughter, the members of the Dai-Gurren Brigade, who had just lost $$カミナ$$, are at first wary of her. But her charm and strength of will win over everyone's hearts, and she becomes something of an idol figure to the group. She has a particularly great influence on $$シモン$$'s growth.
During the decisive battle inside Teppelin, she rides along in Lagann and fights alongside $$シモン$$. After witnessing her father $$ロージェノム$$'s defeat, she speaks of her resolve to move toward tomorrow.
Her cooking skill is so bizarre it traumatizes $$ロシウ$$. Only $$シモン$$ (and $$ブータ$$) seem to find it delicious, and that remains true even now.
Eventually she accepts $$シモン$$'s proposal, but at first, in a moment of obliviousness, turns him down. But after seriously reconsidering what it meant, she accepts. Just as the two seem destined to be joined together, however, the Anti-Spiral factor dormant within her awakens, and she becomes a Messenger.

library.pt_280:r_5c0e2b8317bd6160.text:
A boy from Adai Village, the same village as $$ロシウ$$, and $$ダリー$$'s twin brother.
His parents passed away when he was very young. He and his sister meet $$シモン$$ and the others when they visit Adai Village, and continue on as members of the Dai-Gurren Brigade all the way through to the final battle against the Beastmen.
After the new government is established, he becomes the pilot of a Grapearl, eventually leading a unit while piloting his own personal-colored machine.
However, he has been full of energy to spare since childhood and is bad at sitting still. Having grown up constantly watching the adults of the Dai-Gurren Brigade in action, he has made a fighting style that could charitably be called bold, or less charitably called reckless, into his personal creed. Because of this, the steady, careful $$ダリー$$ is always the one scolding him.

She also served as a brake on the reckless, charging $$ギミー$$.

library.pt_280:r_5030d1f5c5f78d0b.text:
The eldest of the 'Black Siblings' from Bachika Village.
While out working as a Beastman hunter with his younger sisters, he meets $$カミナ$$ and the others. Though he himself denied it, he later obtains a Gunmen under $$カミナ$$'s influence, and after joining the Dai-Gurren Brigade, he consistently distinguishes himself as the leader of the special-attack squad.
He is extremely short-tempered and quick to pick a fight, a rough character with a foul mouth, attitude, and glare to match. His recklessness is second to none, and that never changed even after their victory over the Beastmen.
After the new government was established, he was appointed head of the Justice Department, but struggled with a job he was not used to.

In the midst of the battle against the Anti-Spiral fleet, when the $$超銀河ダイグレン$$ is swallowed by a dense sea of space, he volunteers to destroy the Death Spiral Machine at the root of it. He confesses his long-held feelings to $$ヨーコ$$ before launching, and fulfills his role, but burns out his own life in the process.

library.pt_280:r_7c17fad67d0b6b48.text:
A member of the Dai-Gurren Brigade and head of the new government's Food Department.
He hails from Littner Village, formerly an underground armory, and though mild-mannered, was the village's leader, bravely facing the enemy in battle.
After joining the Dai-Gurren Brigade, he initially fights in his personal machine, the Dayakkaiser, and later becomes acting captain of the Dai-Gurren. With his wealth of combat experience and leadership, he unites everyone and consistently serves as an emotional pillar for those around him.
After peace is won, he marries $$キヨウ$$, with whom he weathered fierce battles together. Blessed with children as well, his sense of responsibility and presence have only grown.

When setting off into space, he struggles with the conflict of leaving his family behind to go to war, but $$キヨウ$$ pushes him to firm up his resolve. In the final battle, he faces the Anti-Spiral head-on with the attack 'My Wife Swings Better Than Anyone in the Universe', answering $$キヨウ$$'s feelings for him.

library.pt_280:r_eae148ceef96d6d0.text:
A member of the Dai-Gurren Brigade and head of the new government's Science Department.
Like $$ヨーコ$$ and $$ダヤッカ$$, he hails from Littner Village, and stands out for his rather feminine mannerisms.
He possesses an unrivaled intellect and is skilled at analyzing information as well. He is also one of the rare few in the Dai-Gurren Brigade who is able to read.
Devoted to research and brimming with curiosity, he becomes interested in Lagann and resolves to accompany $$カミナ$$ and the others. It is in large part thanks to $$リーロン$$'s skill that multiple Gunmen were combined into Gurren, and that the Dai-Gunzan was remodeled into the Dai-Gurren, and he demonstrated his mechanical expertise in many other places besides.
Even after the new government was founded, he continued to play an active role shouldering intellectual labor of all kinds, from unraveling various systems to developing new weapons.

library.pt_280:r_8ea01a6e24275322.text:
The Spiral King $$ロージェノム$$, now a biological computer.
$$ロシウ$$ creates him from a fragment of $$ロージェノム$$'s cells in order to learn the truth behind the words $$ロージェノム$$ left as he lay dying.
He claims not to be the Spiral King himself, but possesses knowledge and memories equal to those he held in life.

library.pt_280:r_b025d879337816e5.text:
A member of the Dai-Gurren Brigade and the new government's Science Department.
A hasty, restless trigger-happy sort, he formerly served as the Dai-Gurren's gunner.
His words and actions never change, in battle or in daily life, and even as the years pass, neither his appearance nor his character have changed one bit.

library.pt_280:r_caa3f495dcbc82bb.text:
